description: This file contains utility functions for handling tensor subclasses and modes in PyTorch's Autograd and dispatch system, specifically related to tracing, wrapping, unwrapping, and metadata management for tensor subclasses within the AOTAutograd framework.

methods.name: bool requires_subclass_dispatch(args, fw_metadata: ViewAndMutationMeta)
methods.description: Determines if the given arguments or output metadata require tensor subclass dispatching at runtime based on traceable wrappers.

methods.name: Optional[MemoryFormatMeta] maybe_suggest_memory_format( t, with_memory_format: bool )
methods.description: Provides a MemoryFormatMeta instance for a tensor if memory format consideration is enabled.

methods.name: dict[type[torch.Tensor],list[type[torch.Tensor]]] get_subclass_typing_container( tensor_subclass: torch.Tensor, )
methods.description: Returns a nested dictionary mapping tensor subclasses to their inner tensor subclasses.

methods.name: create_subclass_metadata( a: Any, start_idx: int, count_symints: bool, with_memory_format: bool = False )
methods.description: Creates metadata for a tensor subclass, including flattened attributes and associated metadata.

methods.name: list[Union[PlainTensorMeta,SubclassCreationMeta]] create_subclass_meta( curr_args: Union[list[Any], tuple[Any, ...]], *, count_symints: bool = True, with_memory_format: bool = False, )
methods.description: Generates metadata for each argument in a list or tuple, handling tensor subclasses and plain tensors.

methods.name: list[tuple[int,SymInt]] enumerate_filter_symints(lst: Iterable[IntLikeType])
methods.description: Captures all SymInt instances (excluding nested ones) from an iterable.

methods.name: list[bool] compute_symint_placeholders(lst: Iterable[Union[None, int, SymInt]])
methods.description: Computes a list indicating which sizes or strides are placeholders for SymInt (True for None, False otherwise).

methods.name: tuple[list[FxValue],list[AOTDescriptor]] unwrap_tensor_subclasses( wrapped_args: list[FxValue], wrapped_args_descs: list[AOTDescriptor], *, append_symints: bool, )
methods.description: Unwraps tensor subclasses into plain tensors, optionally appending size/stride metadata as SymInt placeholders.

methods.name: runtime_unwrap_tensor_subclasses( wrapped_args: list[Union[Tensor, int]], *, append_symints: bool, subclass_metas: Optional[list[Union[PlainTensorMeta, SubclassCreationMeta]]] = None, )
methods.description: Reconstructs tensor subclasses at runtime from flattened dense tensors and subclass metadata.

methods.name: unwrap_tensor_subclasses_with_indices_to_original(wrapped_args)
methods.description: Unwraps tensor subclasses and records the mapping to original argument indices.

methods.name: remap_unwrapped_subclass_arg_indices(wrapped_args, static_input_indices)
methods.description: Remaps argument indices for static inputs considering tensor subclasses.

methods.name: tuple[Any,...] wrap_tensor_subclasses( unwrapped_args: Union[tuple[Any, ...], list[Any]], *, subclass_metas: list[Union[PlainTensorMeta, SubclassCreationMeta]], num_fw_outs_saved_for_bw: Optional[int] = None, included_subclass_symints: bool = False, is_runtime: bool = False, make_subclass_override: Optional[Callable] = None, )
methods.description: Wraps unwrapped dense tensors into tensor subclasses based on provided metadata.

methods.name: Union[tuple[Any,...],list[Any]] wrap_tensor_subclasses_maybe_joint( unwrapped_args, *, is_joint_structure: bool, meta: ViewAndMutationMeta )
methods.description: Handles wrapping for joint structures (primals and tangents).

methods.name: list[int] compute_inner_mutated_inp_indices_from_subclass_meta( fw_metadata: ViewAndMutationMeta, inner_metadata: ViewAndMutationMeta, )
methods.description: Computes indices of input tensors that are mutated, considering tensor subclasses and their component tensors.

methods.name: flatten_subclass( t: FxValue, desc: AOTDescriptor, *, out: tuple[list[FxValue], list[AOTDescriptor]], )
